fusions.name: Tidewrack Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps an arc 3.5 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage to everything caught in it and leaving each [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 20% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Reaping Blade
fusions.desc: Throws a curved blade of coral that deals 15 damage to the first enemy it meets, uses up every affliction you have on it and deals 60% more damage for each one, and leaves it [Marked] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Harvest the Fallen
fusions.desc: Drains every body within 9 tiles (up to 5), each dealing 1 damage and giving back 7% of your health.

fusions.name: Second Cutting
fusions.desc: When you kill something, you regain 5 stamina. Once every 8 seconds.
